{{Quote|The situation here is not what it seems. There is something else behind all this, Your Highness. There is no logic in the Federation's move here. My feelings tell me they will destroy you.|Qui-Gon Jinn|audio=NoLogic-TPM.flac|<ref name="The Phantom Menace" />}}
The '''Invasion of Naboo''',<ref name="TPM VD">''[[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> also known as the '''Battle of Naboo''',<ref name="DB">''[[StarWars.com]] [[Databank (original)|Databank]]''</ref> '''Battle for Naboo''',<ref name="Battle for Naboo" /> '''Subjugation of Naboo''',<ref name="SW:GB" /> or the '''Naboo Blockade''',<ref name="FF3">{{FactFile|3|NAB 1-4|The Naboo Blockade}}</ref> was a significant [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] conflict that occurred on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], where the planet's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]], [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], and surrounding regions were invaded and occupied by the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Army]] of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]].

The Trade Federation was controlled in secret by two [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] in their [[Grand Plan/Legends|plot]] to [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|destroy]] the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and [[Galactic Empire/Legends|rule]] [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]: [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]], also known as Hego Damask of [[Damask Holdings/Legends|Damask Holdings]] and the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]]; and his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], under the guise of popular [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] Palpatine of Naboo. After infiltrating the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], they would ensure the fall of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]] and that Palpatine was elected in his place, with Hego Damask as Co-chancellor.

Two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], were sent as [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassadors]] to negotiate with the Trade Federation. But Darth Sidious ordered the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] leaders of the Trade Federation to destroy them and deploy all forces on Naboo. The Jedi escaped the [[Saak'ak/Legends|flagship]], though. Soon, the Jedi [[Capture of Theed/Legends|rescued]] and escaped with [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], who was under pressure by the Federation to sign a treaty to legalize the invasion. Amidala hoped to have the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] assist in outlawing the Trade Federation's activities on Naboo.

The [[J-type 327 Nubian royal starship/Legends|Naboo Royal Cruiser]] was damaged in the escape, forcing them to divert to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] for three [[Standard day/Legends|days]]. They met the [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] individual [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], who [[Podracing/Legends|raced]] in the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] to win parts for the starship. With the Jedi and the queen on the run, Darth Sidious sent his personal [[Sith assassin/Legends|assassin]], [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]], to track them down on Tatooine. In Maul's [[Duel on Tatooine/Legends|brief duel]] with Qui-Gon Jinn, in which the Jedi Master withdrew aboard Amidala's royal starship, the Sith had revealed themselves to the Jedi Order.

Queen Amidala arrived on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to ask the Senate in Naboo's time of need. But Senator Palpatine, as discussed with Darth Plagueis in private, manipulated and deceived the queen to move for a [[Vote of No Confidence/Legends|Vote of No Confidence]] in the leadership of Supreme Chancellor Valorum. Thus, the Senate would [[Supreme Chancellor election, 32 BBY/Legends|select a new chancellor]]. Amidala then decided to return to Naboo to liberate her people from the Trade Federation's grasp. Upon her return, she met with [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Rugor Nass]] of the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]], and they [[Battle of the Sacred Place|forged]] an alliance.

The [[Gungan Grand Army/Legends|Gungan Grand Army]] was to act as a [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|decoy]] while the queen and the [[Naboo Resistance]] forces stormed the [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Theed Royal Palace]] to capture [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation/Legends|Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]]. The decoy movement succeeded, and the Naboo forces were able to launch [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] to attack and destroy the [[Vuutun Palaa/Legends|Droid Control Ship]]. Skywalker delivered the killing blow to the ship.

The crisis ended with the capture of Viceroy Gunray. As a result, the Naboo and Gungan peoples became closer. On Coruscant, Senator Palpatine, shortly after betraying and murdering his [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]] Plagueis, took the seat of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the Galactic Senate and began rising tensions ultimately leading into the Clone Wars [[22 BBY/Legends|ten years later]]. The events of the Naboo Crisis are often depicted as a prelude to those of the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]].

==Origins==
{{Quote|I will not condone a course of action that will lead us to war.|Queen Padmé Amidala|audio=WillNotCondone-TPM.flac|<ref name="The Phantom Menace" />}}
===Naboo in the galactic community===
{{Quote|Yes, we must be mindful of the concerns of the present electorate, but we shouldn't allow the fearful voices of a few to cripple our chance of joining the galactic community and raising the profile of the entire Chommell sector. I suggest we act boldly. To avoid being perceived as having bowed to pressure, I say we use this unprecedented visit by Damask Holdings to announce publicly that we and we alone are capable of entering into an arrangement with the Banking Clan and others that will allow Naboo to restructure its debt, achieve favored-world status with the Core, and provide for tax cuts, lower interest rates, and endless opportunities for employment, both on- and offworld. We must seize this moment before it disappears.|Ars Veruna, during the Naboo election of 62 BBY|<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />}}
[[The galaxy/Legends|The galaxy]] at large was first exposed to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] in the backwater [[Chommell sector/Legends|Chommell sector]] around [[67 BBY/Legends|67 BBY]], when [[Subtext Mining]] discovered rich veins of [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]]. Members of Subtext Mining were hired by the [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|King]] [[Bon Tapalo/Legends|Bon Tapalo's]] opposition to conduct surveys. [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]], in his guise of Hego Damask of [[Damask Holdings/Legends|Damask Holdings]], visited the world to discuss [[Mining/Legends|mining]] rights. He visited with disgruntled members of the nobility, including [[Ars Veruna/Legends|Ars Veruna]]. Plagueis was able to negotiate with the Naboo to expand their spaceport facilities and build a processing facility on the [[Solleu River/Legends|Solleu River]]. [[Outer Rim Construction and Assembly/Legends|Outer Rim Construction and Assembly]] was contracted to build the facility.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

As part of the deal, Plagueis agreed to finance Tapalo's election to the throne. Damask's support of Tapalo led to the Nubian's election as king and an opening of Naboo to interplanetary trade. King Tapalo and his chief advisors, led by [[Ars Veruna/Legends|Ars Veruna]], succeeded in negotiating a contract with the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] to ship out the plasma from Naboo and sell it to other planets along the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]]. The deal with the Trade Federation allowed a great period of economic prosperity to settle on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] world but the Naboo quickly begun to grow dissatisfied with the result: while they sold their plasma to the Trade Federation for fixed prices, the latter could sell the plasma at inflated prices on the open market, reaping much larger profits than the Naboo. As a result, a great deal of resentment against the Trade Federation developed on Naboo, specifically amongst the Royals who had opposed Tapalo's election to the throne, led by [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Vidar Kim]]. Secretly, Tapalo and his advisors had made a profit themselves for agreeing to the deal with the Trade Federation.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

Veruna, upon his election as King of Naboo after Tapalo's term had ended, became intent on forcing a confrontation with the Trade Federation over control of Naboo's plasma resources. As such, he created a corps of [[Nubia Star Drives, Incorporated/Legends|Nubian Design Collective]] [[N-1 starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. He also planned to have the Trade Federation's part in the transport of plasma from Naboo taken over by the Hutts, namely his ally, [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla Besadii]], whose transports would move the plasma from Naboo to its client worlds, under the protection of [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] and the [[Bando Gora/Legends|Bando Gora]]. The move was opposed by Naboo Senator [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], who later split with Veruna and convinced the young [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], the popular [[Princess of Theed|Governor of Theed]], to run against the king in the following election. Amidala's platform concentrated on a renegotiation of the original contract with the Trade Federation while Veruna planned a more militaristic approach. Eventually, Veruna was [[Foreign Affairs scandal|forced to abdicate]] and Amidala won the throne by a landslide.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

In secret, Plagueis and his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], Darth Sidious—the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] identity of Senator Palpatine—had manipulated events to cause a crisis between the Trade Federation and its client worlds. With Naboo seeking to renegotiate its contract with the Trade Federation, they had what they needed to throw the Republic into chaos. Just as they had secretly replaced Veruna by engineering Amidala's election, they placed their puppet, Trade Federation [[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]], as the overall leader of the conglomerate by having the [[Trade Federation Directorate]] killed during the [[Eriadu Trade Summit]].<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

===The growth of the Trade Federation===
{{Quote|As I told you once before, Viceroy, you serve yourselves best when you serve me.|Darth Sidious to Nute Gunray|<ref name="Cloak">''[[Cloak of Deception]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Inhischambers.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Chancellor Valorum confers with the Jedi]]
An ever-expanding trading alliance, the Trade Federation, headed by the Neimoidian Viceroy Nute Gunray, would purchase victories in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] with their immense resources. As an independent entity, they even had their own [[Senator/Legends|senator]], [[Lott Dod/Legends|Lott Dod]], and went so far as to "persuade" the weapons inspectors of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to ignore the arming of their onetime [[Lucrehulk-class LH-3210 cargo freighter/Legends|cargo craft]]. Secretly, the Federation had converted these shipment vessels into lethal [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|battleships]]. The modifications were made ostensibly to defend against increasing [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] activity in the Outer Rim Territories.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" /> Following the buildup, the battleships and battle droids largely replaced the [[Trade Defense Force]] and its marine forces.<ref name="EGW" />

Gunray was granted a permanent seat on the [[Trade Federation Directorate]] following the acquisition of exclusive shipping rights of [[Lommite/Legends|lommite]] ore from the planet [[Dorvalla/Legends|Dorvalla]] in [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]].<ref name="Maul: Saboteur">"[[Darth Maul: Saboteur]]"</ref>

An invasion force of deadly [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] soldiers was built in addition to the increasing number of the Federation's disguised warships by [[Baktoid Armor Workshop/Legends|Baktoid Armor Workshop]] and [[Haor Chall Engineering/Legends|Haor Chall Engineering]] on schedule but at the cost of an exorbitant amount of credits. They were part of a plot quietly masterminded by Darth Sidious as part of his scheme to establish himself, beneath his public persona of Senator Palpatine, as [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]]. Sidious had approached the Federation's Viceroy Nute Gunray and suggested a test for the new army. Gunray suggested Eriadu, but Sidious countered by suggesting the home of Senator Palpatine, a world which would not respond with force.<ref name="Cloak" />

Later, Sidious contacted them and ordered a fleet assembled.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

[[Deputy Viceroy]] [[Hath Monchar]] left the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] [[Saak'ak/Legends|''Saak'ak'']] in a [[Scout ship/Legends|scoutship]] and took a [[Sith holocron/Legends|Sith holocron]] with information about the impending blockade. Sidious' apprentice, [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]], was [[Skirmish on Coruscant (32 BBY)|tasked]] with recovering the holocron, which he eventually took from the Coruscant information broker [[Lorn Pavan]]. During the hunt for the holocron, Maul engaged and killed the Jedi [[Anoon Bondara]] and his Padawan [[Darsha Assant]], ensuring the secrecy of the return of the Sith. Kenobi investigated their deaths and suspected Black Sun involvement. When Kenobi returned to the Jedi Temple, he discovered that he and his master had been assigned as ambassadors to the blockade.<ref name="Maul: SH">''[[Darth Maul: Shadow Hunter]]''</ref>

===The taxation of trade routes===
By [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]], the Federation's opponents in the Galactic Senate were pressing Valorum to slow the trade organization. The Supreme Chancellor responded by calling for the disbandment of the [[Free Trade Zone/Legends|Free Trade Zones]], albeit granting additional defensive allowances.<ref name="EGW" /> Following the Eriadu incident, the Republic soon passed [[Senate Resolution BR-0371|legislation]] calling for the taxation of [[Hyperspace route/Legends|trade routes]] to outlying [[Star system/Legends|star systems]].<ref name="NEC" /> The reason for this was two-fold; it would serve to weaken the growing Federation, and would recoup funds for the ailing Republic. Unfortunately for the Republic, the Trade Federation felt offended, and was determined to strike back.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" /> The Federation also pursued alliances with the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]], [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]], and [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]], groups which were also affected by increased taxation.<ref name="EGW" />

Jedi Council member [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]] monitored the actions of the Trade Federation following the Summit,<ref name="Cloak" /> and it was her who alerted the Jedi Council to suspicious activities in the Naboo system.<ref name="SW Characters">''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

===The Blockade of Naboo===
{{Quote|This turn of events is unfortunate. We must accelerate our plans. Begin landing your troops.''"<br />"''My lord, is that…''legal''?''"<br />"''I will ''make it'' legal.|[[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] gives orders to [[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]] to ground the battle droids on Naboo|<ref name="The Phantom Menace" />}}
Five months after the death of the Directorate members, and after procuring the necessary resources on a number of planets, including [[Trinkatta Starships|Esseles]],<ref name="Episode I Adventures 1: Search for the Lost Jedi">''[[Episode I Adventures 1: Search for the Lost Jedi]]''</ref> [[Eos]],<ref name="Starfighter" /> and [[Alaris Prime colonial war#Aftermath|Alaris Prime]], the Trade Federation [[Blockade/Legends|blockaded]]<ref name="The Phantom Menace" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] world.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> The invasion fleet gathered at [[Enarc/Legends|Enarc]].<ref name="EGW" />

[[File:NabooBlockade-SWCTP.png|thumb|right|250px|Trade Federation ship form a blockade around Naboo]]

Right after the Blockade commenced, Gunray stated that it was a protest of the new shipping-lane taxes, and threatened that any attempts to break the embargo would be met with deadly force, and was prepared to see Naboo starve unless the regulations were removed. Amidala then contacted Supreme Chancellor Valorum and informed him that the Trade Federation [[Darth Maul/Legends#The Invasion of Naboo (32 BBY)|battleships encircled Naboo]]. Senator Palpatine was there in the office at the time, and told the queen that he could contact the Trade Federation delegates and demand the termination of the blockade. In response, Amidala requested formal Republic intervention. Valorum promised to convene a special Senate session. Once the message ended, Valorum advised Senator Palpatine to prepare to be thrust into the spotlight.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

As the blockade started, head of the Security Forces [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Quarsh Panaka/Legends|Quarsh Panaka]] took the precaution of arming their [[Seraph-class urban landspeeder|Flash]] speeders in the event they would need to cover the queen's escape. He also assigned the Security Forces to patrol Theed and maintain order.<ref name="SVC 62" /> Soon after, the blockade failed to have an immediate effect in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Galactic Core]]. Palpatine made several futile attempts to meet with the Trade Federation's Senator, Lott Dod.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" /> At one point in the blockade, the Federation [[Attempted kidnapping of Queen Amidala|tried to kidnap Queen Amidala]], but the attempt failed.<ref name="Starfighter" />

One month into the blockade, supplies were scarce, leaving the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo people]] with an eerie quiet in the streets and a sense of panic. Amidala's [[Council of Governor]]s advised her to wait while Palpatine tried to find support in the Galactic Senate. Amidala contacted the Supreme Chancellor and told him she was holding him responsible for the blockade, that he was taking bread out of the mouths of Naboo's children. Her words visibly shocked him, but they were successful in convincing him to send aid.<ref name="Amidala journal">''[[Star Wars Journal: Queen Amidala]]''</ref> To stabilize his support base, Valorum used his friendship with Jedi Master Adi Gallia to appeal directly to the Jedi Council to ask for mediators; by not informing the Senate, his actions broke protocol. Master Windu<ref name="NEC" /> secretly [[Mission to Naboo|dispatched]] two Jedi, Qui-Gon Jinn and his Padawan, Obi-Wan Kenobi, to meet with the Federation Viceroy and ensure the Federation's withdrawal from the system.<ref name="The Phantom Menace" />

==The conflict==
===Negotiations===
{{Quote|Is it in their nature to make us wait this long?''"<br />"''No. I sense an unusual amount of fear for something as trivial as this trade dispute.|Obi-Wan Kenobi and Qui-Gon Jinn|audio=TrivialTradeDispute-TPM.flac|<ref name="The Phantom Menace" />}}
[[File:Q-GJ_O-WK_TF.png|thumb|left|200px|Qui-Gon Jinn and Obi-Wan Kenobi escape from the [[Dioxis/Legends|dioxis]]-filled meeting chamber.]]
The two Jedi were scheduled to meet with Viceroy Gunray immediately after arriving at Naboo in the starship [[Radiant VII/Legends|''Radiant VII'']]. However, [[TC-14/Legends|TC-14]], the hostess [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] which they encountered first, promptly informed Gunray, his lieutenant, [[Settlement Officer/Legends|Settlement Officer]] [[Rune Haako/Legends|Rune Haako]], and invasion force [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Daultay Dofine/Legends|Daultay Dofine]], that the ambassadors from Coruscant were Jedi Knights. Terrified at the prospect of facing Jedi, and Dofine having realized beforehand that the Jedi had most likely been sent to force a settlement regarding the dispute, Gunray contacted Sidious and presented the situation, also sending TC-14 to distract them due to Dofine being unwilling to face them. Jinn also noticed that there was an unusual amount of fear among the Neimoidians, especially for what was apparently as minor as a trade dispute. Sidious, realizing Valorum's role in bringing the Jedi to the ship, ordered Gunray to kill the Jedi at once and begin landing his troops on Naboo for an invasion, and when Gunray questioned the invasion's legality, Sidious replied that he would make it legal. Sidious also told Gunray to make sure that any future contacts to him exclude Dofine from participation after the latter implied they should call off the plan due to fear of the Jedi. In order to ensure the Jedi couldn't escape even if they did survive the [[Dioxis/Legends|dioxis]], the ''Saak'ak''{{'s}} docking bay fired its turbolaser turrets at the docked ''Radiant VII'', destroying the ship before its captain could give the order to ready its shields.<ref name="The Phantom Menace" />

The toxic gas dioxis then flooded the ventilation system in the Jedi's waiting room, and Gunray dispatched a squad of [[OOM-series security droid/Legends|security battle droids]] to ensure the destruction of the Jedi. After the OOM droids arrived at the room, Gunray contacted them stating the Jedi should be dead by that point before ordering them to dispose of their corpses. TC-14 exited and asked to be excused as she passed by them. The OOM droid leader, [[OWO-1/Legends|OWO-1]], then ordered [[Unidentified OOM-series security droid corporal/Legends|the corporal]] to go in while they provided cover. Before they could enter, however, Jinn and Kenobi revealed their survival by igniting their lightsabers. The droids attempted to blast them. Jinn and Kenobi, though, proved more than a match for the droids. The commotion did not go unnoticed by Gunray. After learning from [[Tey How/Legends|Tey How]] that they had lost communications with the security droid unit, Gunray ordered the bridge sealed off, although his admission to Haako that he'd never dealt with a Jedi before caused Haako to doubt they'd survive the altercation. As a backup plan, they dispatched [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]], which were more formidable due to their shield generators. Jinn attempted to use his lightsaber to force his way into the bridge, causing Gunray to order them to close the blast doors, believing that would hold them. However, Jinn proceeded to nearly cut through the blast doors to the bridge, much to Gunray and Haako's horror before the latter demanded to know what was taking the droidekas so long. At that moment, the droidekas arrived, ultimately chasing away the Jedi, with one of their blaster fire also detonating the weakened door. Although Haako, who had witnessed this due to the destroyed door, was relieved that the Jedi were no match for the droidekas, How informed them that the Jedi entered the ventilation shaft.<ref name="The Phantom Menace" />

The two Jedi navigated the ship<ref name="SWE1 game">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (video game)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' video game]]</ref> and emerged in a hangar where they witnessed the preparation of several [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|AATs]], [[Multi-Troop Transport/Legends|MTTs]], and [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|C-9979 landing crafts]], causing them to deduce that the Neimoidians were planning an invasion. In order to hide the massive army the Trade Federation had secretly amassed from Republic customs shortly beforehand, the Neimoidians claimed they were simply the components to the latest, expensive [[Binary loadlifter/Legends|Binary loadlifters]] despite their suspicious appearances as well as denying any military purposes to the components.<ref name="Complete Locations">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> Obi-Wan Kenobi, referring to Qui-Gon's earlier assessment regarding to how long the negotiations would take, sardonically commented he was right about the negotiations being short. They then stowed away on separate invasion craft,<ref name="The Phantom Menace" /> with Kenobi forcing [[Unidentified C-9979 landing craft|his]] to make a crash landing on Naboo.<ref name="SW:OW" />

Meanwhile, Tey How reported to her superiors that a transmission from the planet was incoming. Haako realized that the sender was Queen Amidala. Amidala warned the Viceroy that they wouldn't tolerate their blockade any longer and that Valorum had sent ambassadors to meet them. Gunray feigned ignorance regarding the ambassadors, and also claimed that they won't do anything to Naboo without approval from the Senate before claiming she is assuming too much. Haako, as the transmission ended, admitted that Amidala was right about her accusations and implied that they should back out, though Gunray sternly reminded him that it was too late to do so. Gunray, although he was unsure if Amidala did indeed suspect an attack from them, nonetheless ordered that they black out all communications on the planet so they could go on with the invasion.<ref name="The Phantom Menace" />

===The Subjugation of Naboo===
{{Main|Fall of Theed}}
{{Quote|You were right about one thing, Master. The negotiations ''were'' short.|Obi-Wan Kenobi, to Qui-Gon Jinn|<ref name="The Phantom Menace" />}}
[[File:Trade_Federation_Droid_Army.png|thumb|right|200px|The Trade Federation Droid Army advances on Theed.]]
The invasion craft landed in groups of three to cut off Naboo cities from each other.<ref name="Complete Locations" /> Gunray contacted [[OOM-9/Legends|OOM-9]],<ref name="The Phantom Menace" /> commander of the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army]],<ref name="SW:GB" /> warning him of the Jedi's presence among them and to not underestimate them.<ref name="The Phantom Menace" /> From their landing areas in the swamps, the invasion force was sent out towards [[New Centrif]], [[Vis/Legends|Vis]], and [[Parrlay]], in order to [[Subjugation of Parrlay|disable]] the communication transmitters and keep the event secret from Coruscant. [[Capture of Harte Secur|Attacks]] [[Invasion of Spinnaker|started]] on [[Harte Secur]] and [[Spinnaker/Legends|Spinnaker]], the last frontier before spreading to the Naboo capital of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]].<ref name="SW:GB" />

The loss of communications occurred as Amidala was consulting with Senator Palpatine. The failure prompted Theed's [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Sio Bibble/Legends|Sio Bibble]] to say that it was an invasion, with Amidala also expressing disbelief that Gunray would go that far. Captain Panaka of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Security Forces]] (RSF) offered to institute a perimeter to defend Theed, although Amidala reconfirmed her pledge of no fighting.<ref name="The Phantom Menace" /> 

A massive number of civilians across Naboo surrendered immediately, freeing up Trade Federation resources and allowing battle droids to be reassigned to troubled locations. The battle droids were programmed with a set definition of resistance that referred to any refusal to comply with instructions given by the Trade Federation, including refusal to surrender weapons or to leave an injured family member. Controllers in the orbital vessels were sometimes able to interfere with the latter form of resistance, but at other times the droids committed appalling acts of carnage. Many civilians and off-worlders fought back in efforts to escape and later formed resistance movements.<ref name="Fact File 29">{{FactFile|29|NAB 11-16|The Capture of Theed}}</ref>

Amidala switched places with her decoy [[Handmaiden/Legends|Handmaiden]] [[Sabé/Legends|Sabé]].<ref name="Amidala journal" /> Within hours, the armies had [[Capture of Theed/Legends|taken]] Theed, subduing Naboo's small Royal Naboo Security Forces and leaving the planet completely under the control of the Federation. Nute Gunray himself landed in Theed and assumed control from Queen Amidala's own throne room, also declaring victory as soon as one of his droids confirmed the queen's capture. After Amidala refused to sign a treaty legitimizing the occupation, she and her retinue were to be processed into [[Camp Four/Legends|Camp Four]].<ref name="The Phantom Menace" />

However, the two Jedi had survived and reached the Naboo swamps. After having run into local [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] and contacted [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Rugor Nass]] in the underwater [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Otoh Gunga/Legends|Otoh Gunga]], leader of the Gungans, both Jedi Jinn and Kenobi finally made it to Theed. There they found the queen and her entourage held hostage by battle droids. The Jedi made quick work of the droids, and the queen agreed to return with them to Coruscant, where she could plead before the Senate for help against her planet's cruel and abrupt siege.<ref name="The Phantom Menace" />

Getting past the Trade Federation blockade proved difficult, and the [[J-type 327 Nubian royal starship/Legends|queen's ship]] barely scraped by, its shields repaired by [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] at the last moment. Since the [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] was leaking badly during the escape, the group decided to hide on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] until a replacement could be found.<ref name="The Phantom Menace" />

Before they left, Panaka ordered the RSF volunteers to evacuate the city and to engage the Droid Army only in self-defense.<ref name="Battle for Naboo" />

In the following days, Trade Federation continued to take over the planet,<ref name="SVC 62" /> eventually taking complete control.<ref name="The Phantom Menace" /> Due to glitches in the battle droids' [[Programmer/Legends|programming]], particularly in threat recognition, a number of unarmed citizens were mistakenly gunned down.<ref name="SVC 62" /> Following the subjugation of the planet, command transferred from the ''Saak'ak'' to the [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|Droid Control Ship]], and the blockade dispersed.<ref name="The Phantom Menace" />

===Resistance===
{{Quote|Sykes, you've just been drafted into the Trade Federation. Head into that hangar and grab the Trade Federation gunboat.|Captain Kael and Lieutenant Sykes during the attack on the disabled base|<ref name="Battle for Naboo" />}}
[[File:Bfn_security_hangar.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The resistance utilized a number of Royal Security Force [[Hangar/Legends|hangars]].]]
After the queen escaped, the Security Force formed resistance cells, utilizing the Flash speeder in hit and run raids. The droids actively hunted the Security Forces. Following Panaka's evacuation order, the Security Forces gathered what they could, fleeing in speeders, [[N-X Police Cruiser/Legends|N-X Police Cruisers]], or civilian [[Transport/Legends|transports]]. They hid anywhere they could before they got the chance to regroup, although many were killed or captured. The Security Forces, civilians, government officials, and even off-worlders found themselves in hiding and vowing to find a way to strike back.<ref name="SVC 62" />

Naboo's small settlements gave the Security Forces an advantage, as did their knowledge of the local terrain. Lakeside communities were evacuated and their citizens fled to small islands, and gave aid, supplies, and shelter to the resistance. Additionally, the dense swampland confused the droids. The resistance cells tended to be made up of mixed bunches who helped out in small ways.<ref name="SVC 62" />

After escaping from Theed, they [[Skirmishes in the Naboo countryside|assisted]] local farmers and rescued a police officer, [[Vedd Deviss]], who informed them of a mysterious smuggler located in the mountains. Kael, Gavyn and Vedd soon found out that this smuggler was [[Borvo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]. After they [[Mission to the Naboo mountains|escorted]] the Hutt to his [[N-1 assembly site|base]], Borvo joined the Resistance and provided it with starfighters. With the help of Borvo they [[Disruption of Comm 4|destroyed]] the Trade Federation [[Comm 4]] [[Satellite/Legends|satellite]], and [[Attack on disabled base|annihilated]] the disrupted [[Trade Federation base]]. Sykes stole a [[Ostracoda-class gunboat|gunboat]] and used it to [[Liberation of enslavement camps|liberate]] Naboo [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] individuals. However, Borvo soon revealed himself as a traitor and [[Search for Captain Kael|killed Kael]]. Lieutenant Sykes then assumed command and [[Attack on Porso Hill|forced]] the Hutt to retreat to Nal Hutta. With the information from [[Kol Kotha]], Borvo's mercenary, who defected from his former employer, Gavyn [[Liberation of Camp Four|liberated the notorious Camp 4]]. After the queen returned home, Sykes joined the efforts to retake the capital, and [[Battle of the south ridge|destroyed]]<ref name="Battle for Naboo" /> Federation [[Army C]].<ref name="NGVV">''[[The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>

[[File:Habble_rodian_gran.png|thumb|right|100px|[[Mett Habble/Legends|Mett Habble]], member of the Naboo Underground]]

After breaching the blockade, Bravo pilot [[Rhys Dallows]], along with the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Nym/Legends|Nym]], [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] [[Reti]], and [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Vana Sage]], also joined the Resistance. While Reti and Rhys [[Mission in the Naboo canyon|delivered]] the supplies, Vana and Nym [[Battle of the Naboo resistance base|defended]] one of the [[Naboo resistance base|Resistance]] outposts against the Trade Federation attack. They also [[Raid on the Solleu River|rescued]] some Naboo prisoners.<ref name="Starfighter" />

One resistance group, called the [[Naboo Underground]] and led by [[Lucos Dannt]], included a group of off-world students who were sent to [[Royal House of Learning/Legends|Royal House of Learning]] prior to the Invasion, some of whom were even Jedi Padawans. The Naboo Underground conducted a number of successful operations against the occupying forces, primarily involving weapons theft and liberation of prisoners. In one daring operation, they liberated the Naboo [[Minister of Culture/Legends|Minister of Culture]], [[Kyu Tane]].<ref name="Star Wars: Invasion of Theed Adventure Game" />

At one point in the Invasion, the Trade Federation built a secret [[Trade Federation laboratory/Legends|underground facility]],<ref name="TCW ep guide">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars – The Official Episode Guide: Season 1]]''</ref> which [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Nuvo Vindi/Legends|Nuvo Vindi]] took possession of during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] to reproduce the [[Blue Shadow Virus/Legends|Blue Shadow Virus]].<ref name="TCW:BSV">{{TCW|Blue Shadow Virus (episode)}}</ref>

===Return of the Sith===
====Arrival====
{{Quote|Tatooine is sparsely populated. If the trace was correct, I will find them quickly, Master."<br />"Move against the Jedi first. You will then have no difficulty taking the queen to Naboo to sign the treaty."<br />"At last we will reveal ourselves to the Jedi. At last we will have revenge."<br />"You have been well trained, my young apprentice. They will be no match for you.|Darth Sidious and Darth Maul|<ref name="The Phantom Menace" />}}
After finding out that the queen had escaped the blockade, Darth Sidious was furious. He sent his apprentice, Maul, to find the queen and the Jedi, destroy the latter, and bring the former back.<ref name="The Phantom Menace" /> Using an edited [[Holomessage/Legends|holomessage]] of [[Sio Bibble/Legends|Sio Bibble]], Naboo's governor, to pinpoint where the queen's ship may have gone, Maul discovered that Tatooine was that destination.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" /><ref name="Wrath" /> Now was the time for the Sith to unmask themselves to the Jedi after [[1000 BBY/Legends|almost a thousand years]].<ref name="The Phantom Menace" />

After the queen's ship landed on Tatooine, Qui-Gon Jinn went with Amidala (disguised as a handmaiden) and Jar Jar Binks to [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]], where he attempted to barter for parts with [[Watto/Legends|Watto]], the [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] owner of a [[Wald's Parts|junkyard]]. They also met the young slave [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], who invited them back to their home.<ref name="The Phantom Menace" /> Jinn helped him find parts for [[Anakin Skywalker's Podracer/Legends|his podracer]].<ref name="SWE1 game" />

====Second day====
[[File:Sidious_Maul.png|thumb|left|250px|Darth Sidious instructs his apprentice to find the Jedi and the queen.]]
They bartered with Watto and were allowed to enter Skywalker's podracer in the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]]. The Jedi and Amidala helped Skywalker complete his podracer. When cleaning a small cut, Jinn acquired a blood sample, which he sent over his communicator to Kenobi. The sample revealed a startling discovery—over 20,000 [[Midi-chlorian/Legends|midi-chlorians]], things which resided in each individual and allowed them to commune with the Force.<ref name="The Phantom Menace" />

One night during their stay on Tatooine, [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] boarded the Royal Cruiser and captured Queen Amidala. Panaka asked Kenobi to rescue her, and the Padawan chased the Raiders to their burial ground. He confronted the [[Tusken war chief]] and defeated him and was allowed to take the queen home.<ref name="SW:OW" />

====Boonta Eve====
{{Main|Duel on Tatooine (Naboo crisis)}}
Skywalker won the podrace and was granted his freedom, and Watto gave the Jedi a replacement [[T-14 hyperdrive generator/Legends|T-14 hyperdrive generator]]. Young Skywalker agreed to return to Coruscant to be trained as a Jedi. As he packed, Obi-Wan made the necessary repairs.<ref name="The Phantom Menace" />

On his ship, [[Scimitar/Legends|''Scimitar'']], Maul traveled to Tatooine. He touched down on the planet's sand and sent [[DRK-1 Dark Eye probe droid/Legends|probe droids]] to different locations to find his targets. Jinn destroyed one of the probe droids upon discovering it tailing them. Later that day, as the Jedi returned to their ship, Maul ambushed Jinn and his new protégé, Anakin Skywalker. Maul leaped from his speeder and clashed with the Jedi. It was only through extreme concentration that Qui-Gon could defend himself against Maul's heavy attacks. As he fended off a blow from the Sith, Qui-Gon told a puzzled Anakin to leave and tell the Naboo pilot to take off. While he was driven back, Skywalker boarded the Royal cruiser and did as Jinn said. Maul attempted to take Jinn by leaping over him, but Jinn blocked the strike to his back and jumped onto the ramp. Saved from the clutches of the Sith, the queen and her entourage departed Tatooine for Coruscant. Down in the cruiser's boarding ramp, Jinn expressed his worries and introduced Skywalker to his future master.<ref name="The Phantom Menace" />
{{Expandsect}}

===Amidala before the Senate===
{{Main|Skirmish at Coruscant}}
{{Quote|Honorable representatives of the Republic, I come to you under the gravest of circumstances. The Naboo system has been invaded by the droid armies of the Trade…"<br />"I object! There is no proof! This is incredible. We recommend a commission be sent to Naboo to ascertain the truth.|Queen Amidala and Senator Lott Dod|audio=IObject-TPM.flac|<ref name="The Phantom Menace" />}}
[[File:Amidalabeforesenate.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Amidala and Palpatine before the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]]]
The day after the duel on Tatooine,<ref name="Darth Plagueis" /> the Jedi and Queen Amidala arrived on Coruscant following their layover on Tatooine. They were met on the landing platform by Senator Palpatine and Chancellor Valorum. Palpatine brought them to his apartment.<ref name="The Phantom Menace" /> While acting as Palpatine, Sidious, having fully intended to have Amidala captured by Darth Maul, reworked his plot to take into account of her arrival.<ref name="OF novel">[[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']]</ref>

On their way back to the Temple, the Jedi were [[Skirmish at Coruscant|attacked]] by mercenaries led by a [[thug boss]] hired to prevent their return. They defeated the mercenaries and returned to the Temple.<ref name="JPB" />

Count Dooku met with Palpatine, and revealed to him the prophecy of the Chosen One, and that Skywalker was to be tested for Force sensitivity. Plagueis, informed by Sidious in turn, went back to his apprentice's apartment as [[Magister]] Damask of Damask Holdings to see for himself, using a [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]] on one of the handmaidens, but Skywalker had been taken away by Jinn.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

Jinn, Kenobi, and Skywalker appeared before the Jedi Council. Jinn reported his encounter with Maul, leaving the Council to consider the possibility that the Sith had returned after a thousand years. Skywalker was tested, and although he demonstrated Force-sensitivity, he was denied admittance. The Council cited his advanced age as the deciding factor, and ordered Kenobi and Jinn to return to Naboo with the queen and find out what they could about her mysterious assailant to bring the existence of the Sith to light.<ref name="The Phantom Menace" />

In a special meeting of the Galactic Senate, Amidala spoke before the thousands of galactic delegates. Her pleas were instantly called lies and baseless accusations by the Senator of the Trade Federation, [[Lott Dod/Legends|Lott Dod]], who recommended appointing a commission to ascertain the truth. Senator [[Aks Moe/Legends|Aks Moe]] of [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] agreed with Dod. The blatant corruption of the Senate dismayed Amidala, shaking her faith in its ability to govern. Valorum was interrupted by [[Vice Chair/Legends|Vice Chair]] [[Mas Amedda/Legends|Mas Amedda]], and when he spoke to Amidala, it was to ask her if she would defer her motion and allow the commission to proceed. Amidala responded by saying that she would not defer.<ref name="The Phantom Menace" />

At the behest of Palpatine, Amidala shocked the Senate by moving for a vote of no confidence in the leadership of Chancellor Valorum. Although she was reluctant to make the motion, it was taken up enthusiastically by the Senators.<ref name="The Phantom Menace" /> A recess was then called, and Valorum was not seen at the podium afterward.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" /> Amidala, however, was unaware that she had been manipulated and deceived by Palpatine.

Within hours, Palpatine was named one of the nominees to [[Supreme Chancellor election, 32 BBY/Legends|succeed]] Valorum and promised Queen Amidala to clean up the rampant corruption.<ref name="The Phantom Menace" /> [[Bail Antilles/Legends|Bail Antilles]] was nominated by [[Com Fordox]], and [[Edcel Bar Gane/Legends|Edcel Bar Gane]] nominated [[Ainlee Teem/Legends|Ainlee Teem]]. [[Orn Free Taa/Legends|Orn Free Taa]] was the one who nominated Palpatine.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

Against Palpatine's request, Amidala returned to Naboo, deciding that her fate belonged with that of her people.<ref name="The Phantom Menace" /> Back on Naboo, Neimoidian [[Forger (profession)/Legends|counterfeiter]] [[Gode Takrab]] produced a [[Counterfeit Treaty of Naboo|fake treaty]] which showed Amidala in support of the invasion.<ref name="Peril">{{WizCite|book=Secrets of Naboo|story=Peril on Naboo}}</ref> Following his defeat on Tatooine, Darth Maul was ordered to proceed to Naboo to assist in rooting out any resistance. He noticed several flaws in the Trade Federation's strategy, but did not seek to correct them. Infiltrating Naboo secretly, he dismantled several patrols then used the head of an OOM security droid as a comlink to contact Viceroy Gunray and demand that he be recognized as the droid's supreme commander. Once he arrived in the Theed Palace control room, he was briefed by Viceroy Gunray on the resistance, and the Viceroy mentioned several setbacks perpetuated by Lieutenant Sykes' resistance group. He then informed the Neimoidian leadership of the threat the Gungans posed and led the search personally.<ref name="End Game" />

The day before the vote, reports indicated that Amidala assembled the Gungan Army. That night, Damask met holographically with representatives from the various corporations and warned that the Trade Federation leadership had doomed themselves with the blockade, and that the organization would be dissolved. He cautioned the corporations to start a withdrawal from the Senate. He then attended a performance at the [[Galaxies Opera House/Legends|Galaxies Opera House]] with Palpatine.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

Afterward, they joined Free Taa and Amedda and a select group of politicians in a private room at the [[Manari]]. Darths Sidious and Plagueis then retired to his penthouse, where they discussed the plans to make Damask Co-Chancellor. Plagueis, however, was unaware that Palpatine had no intentions on sharing power. Palpatine was ready to eliminate his master. After succeeding in getting the Muun drunk on half-century-old [[Sullustan wine]], Palpatine betrayed his Master by killing him with [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]], fulfilling the next step in the Sith Grand Plan. He basked in the moment, accepting the will of the dark side of the Force.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

Palpatine then won the Chancellorship by a wider margin than predicted. His first duty was to return to his home planet in the aftermath of the Trade Federation's defeat.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

===The battle for freedom===
{{Main|Battle of Naboo/Legends}}
{{Quote|Now, Viceroy, we will discuss a new treaty.|Queen Amidala|audio=ANewTreaty-TPM.flac|<ref name="The Phantom Menace" />}}
[[File:DotF_TPM.png|thumb|left|200px|Darth Maul battles Qui-Gon Jinn and Obi-Wan Kenobi.]]
Darth Maul led the assault personally into the [[Rellias Straits]]. He ordered OOM-9 to draw the Gungans out, then searched for the coordinates of the Gungan city. He met with the former chief of the Security Forces, [[Maris Magneta]], then executed her when she tried to ambush him. He then sought out [[Leika]], who told him of the closest Gungan cities. Maul then captured and tortured Boss [[Ganne]] to find out where the Gungans were hiding. By the time OOM-9's scouts reached Otoh Gunga, the city had been abandoned. Maul then received word that the queen and her Jedi escort were returning.<ref name="End Game" />

When Maul returned to Theed, he ordered the security patrols to sweep the area every five minutes and to increase security at the detention camps.<ref name="Wrath" />

By the time the queen arrived, two days had passed since Otoh Gunga was [[Siege of Otoh Gunga|assaulted]] and the Gungans fled to their [[Gungan Sacred Place/Legends|Sacred Place]].<ref name="TPM novel">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' novelization]]</ref>

Upon their arrival back on Naboo, Amidala and the Jedi formulated a plan to capture Viceroy Gunray in Theed, thus taking back the planet. With the aid of Jar Jar Binks, an [[Battle of the Sacred Place|alliance]] was formed with the proud Boss Nass and the Gungans, and Captain Quarsh Panaka organized all Resistance cells.<ref name="The Phantom Menace" /> OOM-9 was near the Sacred Place at the time.<ref name="SW:GB" /> Flash Speeders were used to ferry the resistance leaders.<ref name="SVC 62" /> Maul secretly watched the meeting in the Sacred Place using his probe droids.<ref name="End Game" />

During the conflict, Master Yoda asked a [[Unidentified Rebel Alliance–affiliated individual|Jedi]] to go to Naboo to assist Master Jinn in stopping the Sith Lord on Naboo.<ref name="Cards">''[[Star Wars: Force Collection]]''</ref>

Members of one of the resistance cells, including [[Pars Varqom]], were contacted by Captain Panaka to join the assault, but were too far from Theed. They were instead assigned to liberate a [[Penladen detention camp|detention camp]] in the [[Penladen Hills]].<ref name="Panaka Cut">{{SW|url=news/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-6-showdown-at-naboo|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 6: Showdown at Naboo}}</ref>

The plan was for the [[Gungan Grand Army/Legends|Gungan Grand Army]] to engage the Droid Army of the Federation in open combat while the queen and the Jedi quietly infiltrated the palace in Theed with the remainder of the Royal Security forces to capture the Viceroy. The small number of pilots in the Naboo security forces would then fly into space and attempt to destroy the only battleship still in orbit: the Droid Control Ship, where all the battle droids were controlled from a single computer brain.

Meanwhile, Maul and the Federation leaders contacted Sidious, who ordered them to wipe them all out.<ref name="The Phantom Menace" /> Maul returned to the Theed hangar and ordered all but sixty droids to reinforce the security platoons, then worked out the upcoming duel with the Jedi in his mind.<ref name="End Game" />

The plan began as intended, but the entire dynamic of the situation changed with the appearance of Maul. The two Jedi engaged the Sith Lord in battle while the queen led a raid into the throne room. Soon after, Amidala and her Security Captain Quarsh Panaka captured both Gunray and Rune Haako. Maul led Jinn and Kenobi through the hangar and into Theed's power generator complex, where Maul kicked Kenobi, who fell several stories. Jinn knocked Maul back and jumped down after him, but the Sith Lord got up.<ref name="The Phantom Menace" /> Maul moved back, surprised by Jinn's stamina.<ref name="Wrath" /> They moved down the catwalk near the refinery.<ref name="The Phantom Menace" />

[[File:Gunray_captured.png|thumb|right|250px|Amidala "discusses" a new treaty with Gunray.]]
The resistance cells occupied the Droid Army's attentions in the streets, drawing attention away from the Palace.<ref name="SVC 62" />

Meanwhile, Kenobi jumped up to the catwalk Jinn and Maul were on, and ran to help Jinn. But Jinn, Kenobi and Maul were stuck behind the laser shields, each cut off from the other. Maul waited impatiently, looking in mocking contempt at Jinn, who was calmly meditating, possibly as an attempt to strike the Sith Lord off guard. The walls shut down, Kenobi ran, and Jinn jumped up and battled Maul once again. At the melting pit, Maul battled the Jedi and mortally wounded Jinn. He then had to face Kenobi. The wall once again shut down and Kenobi was left to face Maul, alone. Maul managed to kick Kenobi into the pit, but Kenobi grabbed hold of a nozzle which was jutting out a little below Maul. The Sith Lord then kicked Kenobi's lightsaber into the bottomless shaft, past the still-hanging Jedi. Calling his Master's lightsaber to him, Kenobi jumped and cut through the Sith Lord's waist. Maul fell into the shaft. Kenobi joined his dying Master who, in his final words, told him to train Skywalker, the fabled "chosen one" destined to bring balance to the Force. Jinn died in a distraught Kenobi's arms. With Maul presumed dead, Amidala's assassination failed, but the Droid Army was still active,<ref name="The Phantom Menace" /> until the [[Vuutun Palaa/Legends|Droid Control Ship]] was destroyed by an unexpected participant in the day's events: young Anakin Skywalker.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

==Legacy==
[[File:Naboo_celebration.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Amidala and Boss Nass holding the Globe of Peace]]
With the defeat of the Trade Federation and the deactivation of its mechanical army, the Invasion was over. Peace and order were restored, as were positive relations between the Gungans and the people of Naboo. Soon after, Palpatine arrived on Naboo with members of the Jedi High Council to oversee the arrest of Gunray and Haako. [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] promoted Kenobi to full Jedi Knight and assigned him to train Skywalker. That evening, Qui-Gon was [[Funeral of Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|given]] a [[Jedi funeral/Legends|Jedi funeral]]. During the funeral, due to being confronted with irrefutable evidence that the Sith had returned, Yoda and [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], knowing that the Sith have operated under the [[Rule of Two/Legends|Rule of Two]], started [[Second Sith theory|theorizing]] that there's still one Sith left out there.<ref name="The Phantom Menace" /> During Jinn's funeral, the recently honored students were approached by Sabé, and asked to help end a minor rebellion by a dark-side force-adept.<ref name="IoTAG:A5">[[Star Wars: Invasion of Theed Adventure Game|''Star Wars: Invasion of Theed'' Adventure Game]], Adventure 5: Renegade</ref> The day after, the Gungans and Naboo [[Freedom of Naboo/Legends|celebrated]] with a parade in Theed, complete with overflights by N-1 starfighters,<ref name="The Phantom Menace" /> N-X Police Cruisers, and [[NB-1S Royal Bomber]]s.<ref name="Battle for Naboo" /> Amidala and Boss Nass shared the [[Globe of Peace/Legends|Globe of Peace]] as a Gungan band played<ref name="The Phantom Menace" /> "[[Symponik Nabooalla]]," a piece created by [[Augara Jowil/Legends|Augara Jowil]].<ref name="Augara DB">{{DB|character|augie|Jowil, Augara "Augie"}}</ref>

After the battle, young Skywalker wrote a journal about his experience with the Jedi.<ref name="Anakin Journal">''[[Star Wars Journal: Anakin Skywalker]]''</ref> The Security Forces and resistance fighters assembled in the Theed Hangar to see both him and his Master off as they left in the [[J-type diplomatic barge/Legends|Royal Starship]].<ref name="SW:OW" /> Palpatine promised to bring Gunray and his lieutenants to justice and end the corruption of the Senate.<ref name="The Phantom Menace" />

Following Skywalker and Kenobi's return to Coruscant, a promising [[Unidentified young new recruit|young recruit]] of the Jedi Order was sent by Yoda to help the Naboo return to a state of peace. The recruit took part in the preparation of the [[Victory Races of Naboo]], a friendly competition between Queen Amidala and General Binks, but also helped eliminate the last few battle droids that lingered in the [[Sacred Forest of Naboo]].<ref name="YCAC">''[[Star Wars: Yoda's Challenge Activity Center]]''</ref>

The students from the Royal House of Learning aided in liberating the Trade Federations remaining prison camps, and cleaning up the deactivated battle droids, when they were reunited with captain [[Nuun Pargen]] of the ''Crescent''. They were also honored in a minor ceremony by the queen.<ref name="PoNE">{{WizCite|book=Secrets of Naboo|story=Peril on Naboo}} Epilogue</ref> The Gungan and Naboo civilizations became closer, with the Gungans colonizing one of Naboo's moons, [[Ohma-D'un/Legends|Ohma-D'un]].<ref name="Gungan Frontier">[[Star Wars Episode I: The Gungan Frontier|''Star Wars'' Episode I: ''The Gungan Frontier'']]</ref>

Many reports were made about the Invasion, as the Battle on the Grassy Plains represented a part of warfare rarely seen in the galaxy at that point.<ref name="EGW" /> Other reports suggested that the droid starfighters performed sluggishly, as the [[Central Control Computer/Legends|Central Control Computer]] also had to direct large numbers of ground forces.<ref name="OF novel" /> Political pundits discussed what Palpatine's election would mean, and if other planets might follow Naboo's lead in challenging galactic powers. Other questions facing the galaxy were if harsher legal enforcement would force an exodus of galactic consortiums from the Republic. For his part, Darth Sidious was disappointed in how easily the Trade Federation was defeated.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

[[29 BBY/Legends|Three years later]], Supreme Chancellor Palpatine forced a stand-down in a secret meeting attended by [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]] of the [[Outland Regions Security Force/Legends|Outland Regions Security Force]]. Over the following months, the Trade Federation's security forces were to be disbanded and assimilated into the Republic. A number of Federation warships were acquired by Tarkin and the Outland Regions Security Force and used in an [[Second Battle of Zonama Sekot|attack]] on the sentient planet [[Zonama Sekot/Legends|Zonama Sekot]].<ref name="RP">''[[Rogue Planet]]''</ref>

Within a month of the end of the Invasion, Jedi Master Dooku left the Jedi Order as a result of Jinn's death and planned on reclaiming his family's title of Count on [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]]. He revealed to Palpatine that he wanted to find the Sith and learn the secrets of the dark side. He also revealed that Master Sifo-Dyas had plans of his own.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

However, after four trials in the [[Supreme Court/Legends|Supreme Court]], Gunray remained Viceroy of the Trade Federation. Gunray, likewise, eventually admitted Sidious' existence and role in the invasion to Count Dooku during this time, who in turn would eventually reveal this to Kenobi [[22 BBY/Legends|nearly a decade later]]. Eventually, Amidala's term as queen expired. Although the Naboo people were willing to amend the [[Constitution of Naboo/Legends|Constitution]], Amidala stepped down, and [[Jamillia/Legends|Jamillia]] was elected as her successor. Amidala then accepted the position as Naboo's senator. Eventually, Dooku was apprenticed to Darth Sidious, but became the public face of the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]].<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref> Gunray continued to despise Amidala for her part in his defeat and sought revenge against her.<ref name="TCW guide">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Episode Guide]]''</ref>

The ascension of Palpatine to the post of Supreme Chancellor was part of the Sith Grand Plan, which had been in motion for a millennium by numerous masters.<ref name="Restraint">{{StoryCite|story=Restraint|book=Darth Maul: Shadow Hunter}}</ref>

Although Maul was believed by the Jedi to have died, he had survived, but was crippled, and ended up going into hiding until he was found by his brother, [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]]. His survival was eventually exposed publicly during the [[Skirmish on Florrum/Legends|Skirmish on Florrum]].<ref name="Wrath" />

In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], [[Director of the Senate Bureau of Intelligence|Director]] of the [[Senate Bureau of Intelligence/Legends|Senate Bureau of Intelligence]] [[Armand Isard/Legends|Armand Isard]] attributed the failure of the Republic to predict the Naboo blockade to the rampant corruption within the SBI prior to his reforms.<ref name="HoloNetNewsWeb-Isard Spearheads Republic Intelligence Reform">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|50|news/1344_3.html|Isard Spearheads Republic Intelligence Reform}}</ref>

==Major players==
===Padmé Amidala===
{{Main|Padmé Amidala/Legends}}
[[File:Queenamidala.jpg|thumb|left|100px|Queen Amidala]]
Padmé Amidala was Naboo's young queen, elected six months before the start of the Invasion.<ref name="NEC" /> Her chief of security, Captain Panaka, worked with her to create a system of decoys for her safety.<ref name="Amidala journal" /> During the blockade, she came before the Trade Federation to plead for her people, and was committed to a peaceful resolution. She was also committed to democracy, and when the Federation invaded, refused to sign a treaty legitimizing her occupation. On Coruscant, it was she who called for the Vote of No Confidence in Chancellor Valorum.<ref name="The Phantom Menace" /> Her leadership is what saved her people from the Federation.<ref name="SW Characters" />

===Qui-Gon Jinn===
{{Main|Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends}}
[[File:Quigonheadshot.jpg|thumb|left|100px|Master Jinn]]
Qui-Gon Jinn was the Jedi Master dispatched by Chancellor Valorum along with his Padawan, Obi-Wan Kenobi, to resolve the Federation blockade. After the Federation terminated the negotiations, Jinn befriended the Gungan Jar Jar Binks and helped Queen Amidala escape.<ref name="The Phantom Menace" /> Jinn was a maverick who believed in the concept of the Living Force,<ref name="Jinn databank">[[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn's]] [[StarWars.com]] [[Databank (original)|Databank]] entry</ref> and believed it was the will of the Force that he discover young Skywalker on Tatooine. The Jedi Master defied the wishes of the Jedi Council in regards to training Skywalker. Jinn, although a strong warrior, fell in battle against Darth Maul during the fight to retake Naboo. Before he died, he told his Padawan to train Skywalker in his stead.<ref name="The Phantom Menace" />

===Rugor Nass===
{{Main|Rugor Nass/Legends}}
[[File:Rugor_Nass_SWGTCG_by_Ekholm.jpg|thumb|left|100px|Rugor Nass]]
Boss Nass of the Gungans was a descendant of Boss [[Gallo/Legends|Gallo]], who had united the [[War of the Gungan tribes|warring Gungan tribes]] [[3000 BBY|three millennia]] previously.<ref name="SW:GB" /> He was mistrustful of the Naboo people, but joyously agreed to help take back the planet from the Federation Droid Army after Queen Amidala humbled herself before him.<ref name="The Phantom Menace" /> He called forth the Gungan Grand Army, which for hundreds of years had only been marshaled for training,<ref name="GB DB">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'' DataBank</ref> Boss Nass agreed to have the Grand Army serve as a diversion to allow Amidala and a strike force to infiltrate Theed and capture Viceroy Gunray. Following the victory, Nass received the Globe of Peace from Amidala<ref name="The Phantom Menace" /> and the two races became closer.<ref name="Gungan Frontier" />

===Palpatine/Darth Sidious===
{{Main|Palpatine/Legends}}
[[File:Palpatine-ROTS.jpg|thumb|left|100px|Supreme Chancellor Palpatine]]
Naboo's Senator, Palpatine was on Coruscant during the blockade. Just prior to when the invasion was launched, he was in communication with Supreme Chancellor Valorum, who assured him that he was sending ambassadors. When Amidala traveled to Coruscant to seek help from the Galactic Senate, Palpatine maneuvered her to call for a Vote of No Confidence in the Supreme Chancellor, who up to that point had been their strongest supporter.<ref name="The Phantom Menace" /> The Senator was quickly added to the list of possible successors.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" /> Amidala soon after returned to Naboo and Palpatine was elected as Valorum's successor.<ref name="The Phantom Menace" /> Palpatine was actually the Sith Lord Darth Sidious, who was the heir of a hidden legacy a millennium long. For decades Palpatine and his Master Darth Plagueis had plotted against the Republic and fostered the corruption in the Senate that had allowed the Federation free reign to launch the blockade. The invasion was only part of the long plot to restore Sith rule to [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. On the eve of the election, Sidious eliminated his Master and accepted the will of the dark side of the Force.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

===Darth Maul===
{{Main|Darth Maul/Legends}}
[[File:Darth_Maul.png|thumb|left|100px|Darth Maul]]
Darth Maul was a Sith Lord and the Apprentice of Darth Sidious.<ref name="The Phantom Menace" /> He had been trained from a young age as a tool who was sent against the Sith Lords' less salient enemies.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" /> After the Trade Federation failed to secure the queen, Maul was assigned to track them down. He discovered that they had traveled to Tatooine, and in his attempt to capture the queen, dueled Jinn. That revealed to the Jedi Order that the Sith had returned.<ref name="The Phantom Menace" /> Following the incident on Tatooine, Maul traveled to Naboo and became a commander of the Droid Army. He personally led the assault against the Gungan city of Otoh Gunga, but it was found abandoned. He then returned to Theed and prepared for the arrival of the Jedi-escorted queen.<ref name="End Game" /> He engaged the two Jedi in a lightsaber duel in the Theed Hangar and killed the Master.<ref name="The Phantom Menace" /> He then taunted the Padawan,<ref name="SW:OW" /> who leapt out of the generator shaft and cut into Maul.<ref name="The Phantom Menace" /> Maul survived his grievous injury and was deposited on the planet [[Lotho Minor/Legends|Lotho Minor]], where he spent over a decade in exile before resurfacing during the Clone Wars.<ref name="Sith Hunters">''[[The Clone Wars: The Sith Hunters]]''</ref>

===Nute Gunray===
{{Main|Nute Gunray/Legends}}
[[File:Gunray_command.png|thumb|left|100px|Viceroy Gunray]]
Viceroy Nute Gunray of the Trade Federation was a longtime ally of Darth Sidious. Following the death of the Trade Federation Directorate members on Eriadu, Gunray advocated striking back, but Sidious convinced him to target Naboo, a world which could not strike back.<ref name="Cloak" /> During the invasion, Gunray questioned the legality of landing ground forces, but was quickly rebuffed. Gunray also had doubts when Sidious was sending Maul to join them. Gunray tried to force Amidala to sign the treaty, but at the end of the invasion, it was he who had to negotiate.<ref name="The Phantom Menace" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Invasion of Naboo was first shown in the first film of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[prequel trilogy]], [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], released in [[May]] of [[1999]].

===Conception===
The screenplay for ''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' was started on [[November 1]], [[1994]]. Although the ''[[Star Wars]]'' universe started in the middle, with the [[original trilogy]], creator [[George Lucas]] had always conceived of the films as being part of a multi-film saga. It was written, like the rest of Lucas' scripts, on loose-leaf paper with pencil in a red binder.<ref name="TPM Souvenir">''[[The Official Star Wars: Episode I Souvenir Magazine]]''</ref>

The Art Department was led by Design Director [[Doug Chiang]]. During pre-production, Lucas and Producer [[Rick McCallum]] met weekly with the Art Department. Costume Designer [[Trisha Biggar]] and her staff of 40 made over 1,000 costumes for the film. Additionally, [[Industrial Light & Magic]] created dozens of full-scale models.<ref name="TPM Souvenir" />

Filming began on the first prequel 20 years after the first ''Star Wars'' had been released, as George Lucas felt that technology had sufficiently matured. Principal photography was done at at [[Leavesden Studios]]. The sets were constructed under the supervision of Production Designer [[Gavin Bocquet]]. Among the sets were the Tatooine slave hovel, the Royal Starship cockpit, Theed Hangar, Jedi Council Chambers, the Trade Federation battleship generator core, and more. Scenes in the Theed Royal Palace were shot at Caserta, Italy, and Tatooine returned to location in Tunisia. Portions of the Gungan city were done in CGI.<ref name="TPM Souvenir" />

The score was done by ''Star Wars'' composer [[John Williams]].

===Alternate viewpoints===
The battle was also represented in LEGO form in [[2005]] in ''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Video Game]]'' and its [[2007]] [[LEGO Star Wars: The Complete Saga|compilation re-release]], as well as the young readers book ''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Phantom Menace]]''.

The [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (video game)|video-game adaptation of ''The Phantom Menace'']] features a mission on Coruscant which contradicts the film; therefore, this article assumes it is non-canon. In the mission, Amidala is captured on the landing platform by the [[Sun Guard]], and Panaka must rescue her, eventually dueling the [[Thug leader]].

There are various inconsistencies between the film and the video-game adaptation, ''[[Star Wars: Episode I Jedi Power Battles]]'', and [[Star Wars: Obi-Wan (video game)|''Star Wars: Obi-Wan'']]. The respective battle articles have more information.
